backend/main.mo: Main Motoko actor defining all data types (User, Video, Comment, CarMeet, MechanicsPost, DirectMessage) and state maps, with mixins for blob storage and authorization. Contains the full backend logic for a car-culture social platform including videos, follows, car meets, mechanics posts, and direct messaging.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report linking the admin panel feature (deleteUser, isAdmin, AdminPanel page, /admin route) to its relevant frontend files, components, and test IDs.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: JSON document containing short summaries of all frontend source files, describing each component, page, hook, and config file's purpose and notable implementation details.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind base CSS file defining OKLCH-based CSS custom properties for light and dark themes including background, foreground, card, border, and sidebar color tokens.
frontend/index.html: Minimal HTML entry point for the RevReel Vite/React app, mounting the React root div and loading the main TSX module.
frontend/src/App.tsx: TanStack Router setup defining all application routes including feed, profile, upload, discover, leaderboard, car meets, mechanics, inbox, conversation, and the /admin route pointing to AdminPanel.
frontend/src/components/AuthGuard.tsx: Authentication guard component that shows a loading spinner during initialization, a neon-styled login prompt when unauthenticated, or renders children when the user has an identity.
frontend/src/components/CarMeetCard.tsx: Card component for displaying a car meet event with category color coding, date/time formatting, organizer name, attendee count, and attend/leave button with auth guard logic.
frontend/src/components/CommentsPanel.ts: A slide-up panel component that displays and submits comments for a given video, with loading skeletons, sorted comment list, and authenticated-only input form.
frontend/src/components/EditProfileModal: A modal dialog for editing a user's profile, allowing updates to username, bio, and avatar image with preview support.
frontend/src/components/FollowButton.tsx: A button component that toggles follow/unfollow state for a user, requiring authentication and showing a loading spinner during mutation.
frontend/src/components/Layout.tsx: The main app layout with a fixed header, bottom navigation bar with route links and an unread DM badge, and a profile setup modal trigger for new authenticated users.
frontend/src/components/PostIssueModal.t: A modal form for authenticated users to post a car mechanical issue with a title, category, and description to the community mechanics board.
frontend/src/components/PostMeetModal.ts: A modal form for creating a car meet event, collecting title, location, date/time, category, and description before submitting via mutation.
frontend/src/components/ProfileSetupModa: A modal dialog component for new users to set up their profile by entering a username, bio, and optional avatar image, then submitting to create a user via the `useCreateUser` mutation hook.
frontend/src/components/VideoCard.tsx: A video card component that handles playback, muting, liking, sharing, deleting, and displaying comments for a single video, with owner-specific controls and optimistic UI updates.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: A custom hook that creates and caches an ICP backend actor (authenticated or anonymous) using React Query, and invalidates dependent queries whenever the actor changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides an `InternetIdentityProvider` context and `useInternetIdentity` hook for managing Internet Identity authentication state, including login, logout, and identity persistence via `AuthClient`.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Centralizes all React Query hooks for fetching and mutating backend data including videos, comments, user profiles, car meets, mechanics posts, and direct messages.
frontend/src/index.css: Global stylesheet that imports Barlow fonts, configures Tailwind CSS, defines OKLCH-based CSS custom properties for light/dark themes, and adds utility classes for neon effects and glassmorphism.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that mounts the React app wrapped with `QueryClientProvider` and `InternetIdentityProvider` into the DOM root.
frontend/src/pages/AdminPanel.tsx: Admin-only page that allows authenticated admin users to delete user accounts by Principal ID, with access control checks and confirmation dialogs.
frontend/src/pages/CarMeetDetails.tsx: Detail view for a single car meet, showing date, location, attendees, and organizer info, with join/leave functionality for authenticated users.
frontend/src/pages/CarMeets.tsx: Listing page for all car meets with category and upcoming/past filters, sortable results, and a FAB to create new meets via a modal.
frontend/src/pages/Conversation.tsx: Direct messaging conversation view between two users, supporting sending, deleting, and auto-marking messages as read with optimistic UI updates.
frontend/src/pages/Discover.tsx: Explore page that aggregates all videos to display browsable category cards and a ranked list of trending hashtags.
frontend/src/pages/Feed.tsx: Main video feed page with 'For You' and 'Following' tabs, vertical snap-scroll through videos, and persistent mute state stored in sessionStorage.
frontend/src/pages/FilteredFeed.tsx: Filtered video feed page that displays videos by category or hashtag, with a back-navigation header and the same vertical snap-scroll layout as the main feed.
frontend/src/pages/Inbox.tsx: Messaging inbox page that lists conversation summaries sorted by recency, showing avatars, unread counts, and message previews, wrapped in an AuthGuard.
frontend/src/pages/Leaderboard.tsx: Leaderboard page displaying top trending videos by likes and top uploaders ranked by total likes, computed from all videos data.
frontend/src/pages/MechanicsHelp.tsx: Community mechanics help forum page that lists user-posted issue cards by category, with a modal for authenticated users to post new issues.
Detail page for a single mechanics forum post, displaying the post content, category badge, author info, and a scrollable comment section with the ability to add or delete comments using React Query hooks.
frontend/src/pages/Profile.tsx: User profile page showing avatar, stats, and tabbed sections for videos and car builds, with support for avatar upload, video deletion, and an edit profile modal for the authenticated user's own profile.
frontend/src/pages/Upload.tsx: Video upload page with form fields for title, description, category, hashtags, and file selectors for video and thumbnail, tracking upload progress and submitting via the useUploadVideo hook.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utility module providing helper functions to read, persist, and clear URL query parameters from both standard query strings and hash-based routing, with sessionStorage fallback support.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration defining a dark-mode theme with custom OKLCH-based color tokens, neon accent colors, custom fonts (Barlow/Barlow Condensed), box shadows, and animation keyframes, plus typography, container-queries, and animate plugins.
project_state.json: Tracks the overall project state for a TikTok-style street racing/car enthusiast short video app, including versioning, architectural notes, existing features, and known issues. Serves as the source of truth for implemented features and requirements.
